# Pack: cds

CERN Document Server records, harvested over the public OAI-PMH endpoint.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `context` |
| Version | `0.1.0` |
| Needs a credential to publish | no |
| Okg modules it needs | `document_starter`, `person`, `extraction` |
| Packs it needs | none |

## In which bundles

- Default in: [`cms-physics`](../bundles/cms-physics.md)
- Optional in: [`cern-team`](../bundles/cern-team.md)

Add it to an instance with `archi add cds`.

## Sources

- `cds.cds`

## Questions

`archi init` asks these. Answer one with `--answer cds_<id>=VALUE`.

| Id | Type | Required | Default | Prompt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | `string` | no | `https://cds.cern.ch/oai2d` | CDS OAI-PMH endpoint |
| `sets` | `string` | no | `["cerncds:cms-pas", "cerncds:cms-notes"]` | OAI sets to harvest, as a YAML list |

The manifest names no credential variable.

## Invariants

The pack owns these checks. They leave with it.

| Name | Severity | What it checks |
|---|---|---|
| `cds_coverage` | error | The CDS source must have live records. Required live subtypes: cds_record. A missing one means the input was empty or the connector regressed. |
